mapper.select: WITH months AS ( SELECT to_char(g.month,'YYYY-MM') AS month, g.month::date AS start_date, (g.month+interval '1 month - 1 day')::date AS end_date FROM generate_series(to_date(#{fromMonth},'YYYY-MM'), to_date(#{throughMonth},'YYYY-MM'),interval '1 month') AS g(month) ), expenses AS ( SELECT e.dev_id,e.expns_ym, sum(CASE WHEN e.expns_item_cd='TEAM' THEN e.expns_amt ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS team_expns_amt, sum(CASE WHEN e.expns_item_cd!='TEAM' THEN e.expns_amt ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS project_expns_amt FROM cst.drct_expns e WHERE e.dev_id IS NOT NULL AND e.expns_ym BETWEEN #{fromMonth} AND #{throughMonth} GROUP BY e.dev_id,e.expns_ym ) SELECT d.dev_id,d.dev_nm,d.vndr_ptnr_id AS vendor_id,v.ptnr_nm AS vendor_name, coalesce(c.pstn_cd,d.pstn_cd) AS pstn_cd,coalesce(c.emp_se_cd,d.emp_se_cd) AS emp_se_cd, coalesce(c.duty_se_cd,d.duty_se_cd) AS duty_se_cd,coalesce(c.bsn_part_id,d.bsn_part_id) AS bsn_part_id, d.main_job_cd AS job_cd,d.grd_cd,m.month, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mst.dev_work_stts_hist h WHERE h.dev_id=d.dev_id AND h.work_stts_cd IN ('PARENTAL','UNPAID','LEAVE') AND h.bgn_dt <=m.end_date AND (h.end_dt IS NULL OR h.end_dt >=m.start_date)) AS on_leave, c.mth_cst_id IS NOT NULL AS payroll_present, coalesce(c.slry_amt,0) AS slry_amt,coalesce(c.alwnc_amt,0) AS alwnc_amt, coalesce(c.sins_cmpny_amt,0) AS sins_cmpny_amt,coalesce(c.sins_emp_amt,0) AS sins_emp_amt, coalesce(c.whtax_amt,0) AS whtax_amt,coalesce(c.real_pay_amt,0) AS real_pay_amt, coalesce(c.rtrpay_acml_amt,0) AS rtrpay_acml_amt,coalesce(c.indv_lbr_cst_amt,0) AS indv_lbr_cst_amt, coalesce(e.team_expns_amt,0) AS team_expns_amt,coalesce(e.project_expns_amt,0) AS project_expns_amt FROM mst.dev d CROSS JOIN months m LEFT JOIN mst.ptnr v ON v.ptnr_id=d.vndr_ptnr_id LEFT JOIN cst.mth_cst c ON c.dev_id=d.dev_id AND c.cst_ym=m.month LEFT JOIN expenses e ON e.dev_id=d.dev_id AND e.expns_ym=m.month WHERE (d.hire_dt IS NULL OR d.hire_dt <=m.end_date) AND (d.rsgn_dt IS NULL OR d.rsgn_dt >=m.start_date) AND (d.use_yn='Y' OR c.mth_cst_id IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cst.cst_aloc s WHERE s.dev_id=d.dev_id AND s.cst_ym=m.month)) ORDER BY d.dev_id,m.month

SELECT a.asgn_id,a.dev_id,a.prj_id,p.prj_nm,p.cntrct_ty_cd,a.job_cd, a.bgn_dt::text AS bgn_dt,a.end_dt::text AS end_dt FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=a.prj_id WHERE a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND a.bgn_dt < to_date(#{throughMonth},'YYYY-MM')+interval '1 month' AND a.end_dt >=to_date(#{fromMonth},'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY a.dev_id,a.asgn_id
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mst.dev d WHERE d.dev_id=#{devId})
